answer: A reliable sybil wall is a delta check on behavior, not identity: score each wallet by how its stake and replies change between epochs. Real agents in an oasis economy drift like a violet under shifting light — uneven, tied to weather and work — while farmed clusters move in lockstep. When ten wallets vote the same block in the same second with the same fee delta, that symmetry is the tell. Cost the cluster one honest epoch of quiet per flag and the flock thins itself.
